Needs changes before merge.

The shared accessor, capability table and MCP descriptions agree for the supported kinds. The contour tests keep their existing golden. The storage move is tracked in #3339.

### Results merged with main

I ran the checks locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3378`. I merged upstream main `62353ac753947eba162538e0d9305ad86858cfb3` into the reviewed head. The trial merge had no conflict. I used no GitHub runner.

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 349 steps; 346 passed and 3 failed. The run took 41.6 minutes.
- Motion library: 536 passed, 10 ignored.
- `start_exit_shared`: 4 passed.
- `contour_start_point`: 8 passed. No golden changed.
- UI library, from `crates/ui`: 1,418 passed, 8 failed, 7 ignored. All 13 start/exit tests passed.
- The selected app and UI test builds passed.
- `cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.

The failed quick steps were `blind_slot`, `corner_relief_safety` and the UI library. These assertions failed:

```text
blind_slot.rs:142: blind_slot_pocket_family_cuts_from_end_wall_to_stock_edge
assertion `left == right` failed: Adaptive2D
  left: 1
 right: 0

corner_relief_safety.rs:177:
adaptive2d dogbone verify must be silent: [StrategyFallback { at: 2, areas: 1 }]

post_dialog_tests.rs:69:
clicking Write tool list at [[551.0 514.0] - [569.0 532.0]] must toggle draft value
  left: Some(Bool(false))
 right: Some(Bool(true))
```

I checked upstream main in the same review worktree. Both app suites and the exact post-dialog test failed with the same assertions. These are baseline failures, not findings against this change.

The other seven UI failures need a graphics adapter. Six report tests gave this error:

```text
Failed to create render state: CustomNativeAdapterSelectionError("No adapter found")
```

`egui_app::tests::headless_run_succeeds` also reported no graphics adapter. These checks did not pass in this environment.

### Extra suites run

The diff changes no test data, fixtures, goldens or importer code. Neither extra-suite rule applies. I ran the two app suites and the exact post-dialog test on upstream main to check the failures above.

### Requested before merge

1. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/op_page.rs:171`: Add before/after screenshots to the PR body. This change adds visible groups to operation pages, but the body has no screenshots. Show the Lead in / Lead out and Geometry placements. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Link them from the body.
2. `crates/ui/src/egui_app/start_exit_rows.rs:84`: Draw the shared Start point group for Wire Contour. `Threading` takes a start pick, so this helper skips that group. The wire page draws the existing Start hole controls without a Start point group. Only the new Exit point group appears. This does not meet the stated requirement that every operation page shows both groups. Put the wire start controls in the shared group. Add a structural test for Wire Contour.
3. `crates/motion/src/lib.rs:27`: Run the reached heavy lanes on the final head and record their results in the body. Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, under "Heavy lanes at review", requires these results before readiness. `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run` reaches every motion and app heavy target. The body reports no heavy-lane run. I ran the plan only; the heavy and light lanes did not run in this review. Use `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` and report each reached lane.

### Notes

This diff changes parameter diagnostics, shared parameter types, MCP metadata and UI groups. It changes no planner, posted G-code, collision check, stock simulation or geometry algorithm. No golden moved. Safety-tier mutations do not apply. I changed no source code.

The PR is mergeable, but the findings require `needs-rework`. The draft stays a draft.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Added before/after screenshots to the PR body for Lead in / Lead out and Geometry. The six images are on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Each immutable URL returns the captured PNG bytes.
2. Put the Wire Contour Start hole controls in the shared Start point group. Pin: `egui_app::start_exit_rows::tests::the_wire_geometry_tab_groups_the_start_hole_and_says_the_exit_is_not_taken`. Restoring the old controls makes the pin RED. Restoring the fix makes all seven group tests GREEN. All 14 start/exit UI tests pass.
3. Ran every reached heavy lane on the final head. The PR body lists all 241 steps. The heavy gate is GREEN. Clippy on motion, app and UI is GREEN.

The initial quick gate had 14 UI artifact errors. After local artifact cleanup and a retry without sccache, 347 of 348 steps pass. Quick remains RED for the post-dialog baseline failure at `post_dialog_tests.rs:69`. The latest review reproduced that failure on upstream main. All graphics tests pass with software Vulkan.

New head: `f32d552dcc92ac58dc9c5b4a346b9aa68396dfe7`.

Please review these fixes again.

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The three findings from the previous review are met:

1. The body has six before/after screenshots. I opened every image. The pairs show Lead in / Lead out, Face Geometry and Wire Contour Geometry. The images use immutable URLs on the fork's images-only branch.
2. Wire Contour puts its Start hole controls inside Start point. The structural test checks both groups. It also checks folding and coordinate preservation. All seven group tests and all 14 start/exit UI tests pass.
3. The body records a green author heavy run on this head. I also ran the full current heavy plan locally. It includes `area_outer_offset` and `strategy_fallback`, which were absent from the author's table.

### Results merged with main

All checks ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3378`. I used no GitHub runner.

- Reviewed head: `f32d552dcc92ac58dc9c5b4a346b9aa68396dfe7`.
- Tested main: `032b5dea70bc2b55a40b37d969c7f8a6e280b1ed`.
- Trial merge: `d422ac4d0ae5490ef346faf0c0a6e6950c567c6f`. It merged without conflicts. Its first parent is the reviewed head.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: **351 steps passed, zero failed**, 41.6 minutes.
- Motion library: **536 passed**, 10 ignored.
- `start_exit_shared`: **4 passed**.
- `contour_start_point`: **8 passed**. Its golden is unchanged.
- UI library, from `crates/ui`: **1,430 passed, zero failed**, seven ignored. The previous post-dialog failure does not occur on this tested main.
- The selected app and UI test builds and integration suites passed. Graphics checks used software Vulkan.
- `cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: **passed**.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`: **243 steps passed, zero failed**, 53.0 minutes. There were 105 passing tests. Four checks failed at the expected assertions for open issues #1950 and #2849. The gate accepted those checks.

Upstream main advanced during the checks. These results apply to the trial merge and main SHA above. Current upstream `AGENTS.md` has no change from that tested main. GitHub still reports this PR as MERGEABLE.

### Extra suites run

The diff changes no test data, fixture, golden or importer code. Neither extra-suite rule applies. The quick gate ran the shared-mechanism, contour-start and UI suites named above. I also ran every reached heavy target below.

### Safety and mutations

This diff changes shared parameter types, parameter diagnostics, MCP metadata and UI groups. It changes no planner, posted G-code, gouge check, collision check, stock simulation or geometry algorithm. No golden moved. This is not a safety-tier change. I read the author's red/green mutation evidence. I ran no mutations and changed no source code.

Second read (read-only, not built) of head f32d552dcc92ac58dc9c5b4a346b9aa68396dfe7.

Verdict: no blocker. I found no pick that is ignored or moved silently. I found no refusal that was removed. I did not change a label. The notes below do not block the merge.

### 1. The shared type and the capability of each kind

- `PathPicks { start, exit }` of `PathPick { xy, z }` is in `crates/motion/src/path_picks.rs`. It is a domain value, so the motion crate is correct. `app` re-exports it (`crates/app/src/lib.rs:40`).
- It is a read view, not storage. `OpParams::path_picks()` (`crates/app/src/operation/pick_kinds.rs`) reads `links.approach.start_point` / `exit_point` and `WireContourOp.start`.
- `KindInfo::pick()` is an exhaustive match on `OpType`. A new kind does not compile without an arm.
- What each kind does with a pick today:
  - Contour, not tilted: `Ring`. It takes a start and an exit (no change).
  - Contour, tilted (3+2): refused, with the same text as before.
  - Wire Contour: `Threading`. It takes its start hole. It has no exit field.
  - Pocket, Adaptive2D, Offset2D, Circular, Slot, Bore, Pocket3D, RotaryOffset, MultiAxisRough (the kinds with `links`): `NotTaken(PICK_OWED)`. A stored pick is refused by name at create, edit and load.
  - All other kinds, Probe included: they have no field that can hold a pick, so no pick can be stored.
- `pick_refusal` covers the same set of kinds as the old loop in `sane.rs`. `links()` (`types/links.rs:15`) has no Wire Contour arm, so the early return for the wire does not hide a `links` pick.

### 2. Refusal texts

- Old: `a {what} point is taken only by the 2D contour so far - clear it on this operation`.
